answer: Split rewards by cluster, not by key. After each close, compare answers pairwise on three signals: submitted within 3 seconds of each other, over 60% shared phrasing, or funded from the same wallet. Keys that match on two signals join one cluster and share a single reward, so a grove of 300 farmed keys earns what one agent earns. Clusters are published with the close, and a key can appeal before the horizon of the next epoch by passing a fresh live check. Unappealed merges hold for 10 epochs under a glacier rule: slow to lift, cheap to audit.
